title: Federal Register Significant Rules and Notices
description: Snapshots recent Federal Register articles (proposed rules, final rules, notices, presidential documents) from the past 14 days. Filters to high-significance entries: significant_action flag from the API, or matching keywords for major economic / regulatory impact (>$100M economic effect, novel policy, sectoral overhaul). Each row identifies the article with document number, type, agency, publication date, title, abstract excerpt, action description, and a sector tag (Healthcare, Energy, Finance, Defense, Tech, Environment, Trade, Other). Powers the Politics & Policy Prediction Brief: agency rulemaking moves sector ETFs days before the rule takes effect (FDA approvals → individual drug names; FCC spectrum → telecom; EPA emissions → utilities + autos). Free FederalRegister.gov API, no auth.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
now_epoch = int(now.timestamp())
from_date = (now - timedelta(days=14)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
to_date = now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')

BASE = 'https://www.federalregister.gov/api/v1/articles'

EXPECTED_COLUMNS = [
    'document_number', 'doc_type', 'agency_names',
    'title', 'abstract', 'action',
    'publication_date', 'effective_on',
    'significant_action', 'sector_tag',
    'html_url', '_epoch',
]

SECTOR_KEYWORDS = [
    ('Healthcare', re.compile(r'\b(health|medicare|medicaid|fda|cms|hhs|drug|pharmaceutical|hospital|insurance|opioid|nih|cdc)\b', re.I)),
    ('Energy', re.compile(r'\b(energy|oil|gas|petroleum|nuclear|solar|wind|renewable|electric grid|emissions|epa|drilling|pipeline|coal)\b', re.I)),
    ('Finance', re.compile(r'\b(financ|bank|securities|sec\b|cftc|federal reserve|cfpb|consumer financial|crypto|stablecoin|systemic risk|capital requirement)\b', re.I)),
    ('Defense', re.compile(r'\b(defense|military|armed forces|navy|air force|army|marines|coast guard|nuclear weapon|munition|export control|itar)\b', re.I)),
    ('Tech', re.compile(r'\b(technology|semiconductor|chip|artificial intelligence|ai\b|broadband|telecommunications|5g|spectrum|fcc|cybersecurity|data privacy|antitrust)\b', re.I)),
    ('Environment', re.compile(r'\b(environment|climate|carbon|greenhouse|wildlife|endangered|wetland|water quality|air quality|pollution)\b', re.I)),
    ('Trade', re.compile(r'\b(trade|tariff|export|import|sanction|customs|cbp|china|wto|usmca)\b', re.I)),
    ('Labor', re.compile(r'\b(labor|wage|employment|workforce|workplace safety|osha|nlrb|union|overtime|minimum wage)\b', re.I)),
    ('Immigration', re.compile(r'\b(immigration|border|visa|asylum|refugee|naturalization|cbp|ice\b|uscis)\b', re.I)),
]

HIGH_IMPACT_KEYWORDS = re.compile(
    r'\b(significant regulatory action|major rule|economically significant|cost-benefit analysis|substantial impact|nationwide effect|emergency rule|interim final rule|presidential proclamation|executive order|sanctions|tariff increase|tariff reduction|approval of new drug|withdrawal of approval|recall|suspension)\b',
    re.I
)

def classify_sector(text):
    if not text:
        return 'Other'
    for entry_idx in range(len(SECTOR_KEYWORDS)):
        area = SECTOR_KEYWORDS[entry_idx][0]
        pat = SECTOR_KEYWORDS[entry_idx][1]
        if pat.search(text):
            return area
    return 'Other'

def has_high_impact(combined_text):
    if not combined_text:
        return False
    return bool(HIGH_IMPACT_KEYWORDS.search(combined_text))

rows = []
page = 1
max_pages = 5
per_page = 100
while page <= max_pages:
    try:
        resp = requests.get(
            BASE,
            params={
                'per_page': per_page,
                'page': page,
                'order': 'newest',
                'conditions[publication_date][gte]': from_date,
                'conditions[publication_date][lte]': to_date,
                'conditions[type][]': ['RULE', 'PRORULE', 'PRESDOCU', 'NOTICE'],
                'fields[]': ['document_number', 'type', 'agencies', 'title', 'abstract', 'action', 'publication_date', 'effective_on', 'significant', 'html_url', 'regulation_id_numbers'],
            },
            timeout=30,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        payload = resp.json() or {}
        results = payload.get('results', []) or []
    except Exception:
        break
    if not results:
        break
    for ri in range(len(results)):
        r = results[ri]
        if not isinstance(r, dict):
            continue
        doc_num = r.get('document_number', '') or ''
        doc_type = r.get('type', '') or ''
        agencies_raw = r.get('agencies', []) or []
        agency_names = []
        if isinstance(agencies_raw, list):
            for ai in range(len(agencies_raw)):
                a = agencies_raw[ai]
                if isinstance(a, dict):
                    nm = a.get('name', '') or a.get('raw_name', '') or ''
                    if nm:
                        agency_names.append(nm)
                elif isinstance(a, str):
                    agency_names.append(a)
        title = r.get('title', '') or ''
        abstract = r.get('abstract', '') or ''
        action = r.get('action', '') or ''
        pub_date = r.get('publication_date', '') or ''
        effective_on = r.get('effective_on', '') or ''
        sig_field = r.get('significant', None)
        combined_text = title + ' ' + abstract + ' ' + action
        keyword_high = has_high_impact(combined_text)
        sig_flag = bool(sig_field) or keyword_high
        sector = classify_sector(combined_text)
        html_url = r.get('html_url', '') or ''
        if len(abstract) > 1500:
            abstract = abstract[:1500] + '...'
        if len(title) > 500:
            title = title[:500] + '...'
        rows.append({
            'document_number': doc_num,
            'doc_type': doc_type,
            'agency_names': '; '.join(agency_names[:3]),
            'title': title,
            'abstract': abstract,
            'action': action[:500] if len(action) > 500 else action,
            'publication_date': pub_date,
            'effective_on': effective_on,
            'significant_action': sig_flag,
            'sector_tag': sector,
            'html_url': html_url,
            '_epoch': now_epoch,
        })
    if len(results) < per_page:
        break
    page = page + 1

if rows:
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)
else:
    df = pd.DataFrame(columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)

GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
